style.name: Paper Diorama (Lion Roar brand palette)
style.palette_lock: near-black ink backgrounds (#0c0b0e), off-white (#f5f4f1) and pale grey paper monochrome, with ONE soft violet (#aa83fa) paper accent; no sepia, no brown, no gold, no other colors
style.formula: cinematic paper-diorama documentary in the Lion Roar brand palette: miniature table-top worlds built from off-white and pale grey newsprint and cardboard on near-black ink backdrops, torn layered paper edges, monochrome halftone print texture, anonymous halftone cutout figures with obscured faces, one single soft violet paper accent, distressed letterpress texture on props, warm tungsten documentary lighting with deep ink-black shadows, macro tilt-shift shallow depth of field, film grain and floating paper dust, smooth handcrafted stop-motion motion, non-photorealistic handcrafted paper materials only.
style.motion: smooth simple handcrafted motion, subtle stop-motion feel
